s01.title: What we collect
s01.intro: As a member of {product} we process the following:

account.v: Email, chosen handle, display name, bio, tier, joined date.

training.v: Logged sets (weight, reps, RPE, timestamp), program assignment, weekly progression, completed sessions.

formChecks.v: Video uploads (private bucket), AI-generated assessments, coach notes.

wearable.v: If you connect a wearable (e.g. Whoop): recovery, sleep, strain/workout, cycle and basic profile data — only with your explicit consent. See section 09.

journal.v: The text you write in your journal (pillar 5). Munk, coaches and other members cannot read it. An excerpt may be sent to Anthropic (Claude Haiku) for crisis-text moderation.

mindCheck.v: Daily signal: energy, stress, focus, and an optional note. The note may be included in the daily mental coach (Anthropic Claude Sonnet).

mentalCoach.v: AI-generated daily reflections, session completions, and your mental settings. Output is stored so you can re-read it.

cirkler.v: Posts and reactions in mental circles, if you share. Visible only to circle members.

nutrition.v: Nutrition profile, meal plans, logs and skip-days — health data (art. 9).

messages.v: 1:1 threads with a coach (text and media paths).

reps.v: Reps balance, transactions, redemptions. Stripe handles payment data — we only store a customer ID.

technical.v: Session cookie, IP address for logging purposes, request timestamps.

deliver.v: Personalized program, form-check, nutrition, HRV, mind-check, journal moderation, daily mental coach, community feed, Reps loyalty.

notify.v: Coach notes, @mentions, weekly digest, tier-up. You can turn off each type under Settings.

improve.v: Aggregated usage — no individual tracking profiles.

s03.title: Who we share with
s03.intro: We only share data when it is strictly necessary for the service:

supabase.v: Database and auth — EU region (Frankfurt). Data processor under a DPA.

resend.v: Transactional email — sends on our behalf. EU/USA, Standard Contractual Clauses.

stripe.v: Payment processing — you enter card details directly with Stripe; we never see them.

anthropic.v: AI program generation, form-check assessment, crisis-text moderation of journal excerpts (Haiku), and the daily mental coach from your mind-check including optional note (Sonnet). Anthropic is a processor. On their business tier, prompts/output are not stored beyond the request lifecycle.

s03.outro: We never sell your data. We don't share it for marketing without explicit consent.

access.v: Export your own member rows as JSON from Settings → Data (GDPR art. 20).

rectify.v: Update your profile under Settings or write to us.

delete.v: Delete your account permanently under Settings → Danger zone.

restrict.v: Write to {email} — we respond within 30 days.

complain.v: You can complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency if you believe we process your data incorrectly.

s05.title: Cookies
s05.bodyBefore: We use a single strictly necessary cookie (
s05.bodyMid: / Supabase auth cookie) to keep you signed in. It is stored as long as your session is active, or 30 days max. We do
s05.bodyAfter: use analytics cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party advertising cookies.

s06.title: Retention
s06.body: Active membership data is stored as long as your account exists. When you delete your account everything is permanently removed within 30 days (up to 90 days if backup rotation requires it). Accounting data from Stripe is kept for 5 years per Danish bookkeeping law.

s07.title: Changes
s07.body: We update this policy when functionality changes. Material changes are announced by email to registered members at least 14 days before they take effect.

s08.title: Special categories (GDPR art. 9)
s08.intro: Journal, mind-check, mental coach, circles, HRV/biometrics and nutrition are health data. We process them only when you use those modules.

category.v: Health data (art. 9) — text about mental health, biometric HRV readings, nutrition and weight data.

basis.v: Explicit consent (art. 9(2)(a)): the Mind onboarding acknowledgement, and for wearables the provider OAuth. There is no separate per-category consent checkbox in this version.

stop.v: Stop processing by stopping use of the module and deleting your account. A wearable connection can be disconnected under Settings (see section 09).

s09.title: Wearable integrations
s09.intro: {product} can connect to your wearable so training can adapt to your recovery. The integration is voluntary and only starts after you explicitly consent in the provider's OAuth flow.
s09.whoopLead: Whoop: When you connect your Whoop account, we fetch the following on your behalf via Whoop's API:

recovery.v: Daily recovery score, resting heart rate, HRV.

sleep.v: Sleep duration, sleep stages, sleep performance.

profile.v: Name and basic profile data from your Whoop account.

s09.use: These data are used to personalise your program and form feedback inside {product}. They are stored in the EU (Supabase, Frankfurt) and never sold.
s09.disconnect: You can disconnect at any time under Settings. When you do, the connection is set to revoked and we stop using our Whoop access token. Already fetched readings and connection metadata are not deleted automatically — they are kept until you delete your {product} account. There is no 30-day deletion job on disconnect. You can also revoke access directly in your Whoop account.

terms.title: The ground rules.
terms.introBefore: Last updated: May 2026 · By using {product} you accept these terms. Questions?

s01.title: The service
s01.bodyBefore: {product} is a closed coaching platform provided by {entity}

s01.bodyAfter: . We give access to AI-generated strength training programs, video-based form feedback, a community of crew members, and a Reps loyalty program. Access requires an invite code and active membership.

billed.v: Monthly in advance via Stripe. Price is shown clearly before checkout.

cancel.v: Anytime from the Billing page. Takes effect at the next billing cycle — no refund for the current period.

addon.v: Limited spots, separate terms — we cancel manually if no spot is available.

priceChanges.v: Announced 30 days in advance. You can cancel before the change takes effect.

s03.title: Health disclaimer
s03.p1Emphasis: You train at your own risk.
s03.p1: Our coaching and AI feedback do not replace medical or physiotherapy advice. You should consult a doctor before starting a new training program, especially if you have existing injuries, heart conditions, or other health issues.
s03.p2: AI form checks are a technical assessment, not a final quality assurance. Mikael Munk reviews personally within 24 hours, but the responsibility to lift safely lies with you.

personal.v: Your account is personal. Don't share logins or invite codes.

respect.v: In the crew feed: constructive feedback, no hate, no ads, no spam.

content.v: You keep copyright to your posts and videos. We have a perpetual license to display them within the platform.

suspension.v: We can suspend accounts that break the rules. We give notice and a chance to fix it where possible.

s05.title: Reps and redemptions
s05.p1: Reps have no cash value and cannot be converted to money or transferred between members. They don't expire — but if you delete your account or cancel your membership, you lose access to both your balance and redemptions.
s05.p2: Limited drops are shipped with GLS once Mikael confirms — typically within 5 business days. Custom-embroidered products have a 2-3 week delivery time.

s06.title: Limitation of liability
s06.body: Our total liability toward you is limited to the amount you have paid in membership over the past 12 months. We are not liable for indirect losses, lost profits or damages resulting from the service being unavailable. This does not limit liability that cannot be waived under Danish law.

s07.title: Governing law + disputes
s07.body: These terms are governed by Danish law. Disputes that cannot be settled amicably are decided by the Copenhagen City Court as the court of first instance.
